P1.source: Read AppendixD pp.19-22 in full for assumptions, programs, both lemmas and runtime; visually checked original pp.19 and22. Compared with the separate general Algorithm1.
P1.independent_argument: With S=[0,1], E=1[x>=1/2], q+=(3/4),q-=(1/4), utility=.5E(x)(x-s). The active cell is nonempty closed convex and has a trivial separation oracle. Its unique linear minimizer is.5 with worst payoff.25. The null prediction0 achieves0 for all s, while adversary s=0 makes every possible payoff nonnegative; full continuum minimax is therefore exactly0. Restriction has gap.25 at every epsilon<.25. The LemmaD.4 pushforward of delta0 has total mass0. This is a continuum certificate, not reliance on grid LP.
P1.alternative_and_dependency: No exhaustive cover assumption appears: sumE<=1. Exhaustive nonempty attained cells restore mass transfer, or an accessible zero-payoff null representative fixes this example; adding a positively weighted new event changes the game. With u1=0,u2=s and lexicographic ties to1, the action2 cell(0,1] has unattained positive-linear infimum, so the polytope/attainment claim needs qualification. General Algorithm1 does not use this candidate reduction.
P1.severity_and_repair: Corrected to Major for the invalid core reduction and false advertised epsilon-optimality of the accelerated method. Survival of the separate general algorithm and ease of the one-example repair do not validate this theorem. General null-region access, empty/open cells, reversed dominance inequality and precision/runtime repair remain explicitly unverified.

P2.source: Read Definitions2.1/2.2 pp.3-4, outer/inner proof p.5, full Section3.1 p.7 and Theorem4.1 proof p.9. Viewed source pp.3 and7 for exact expectation placement. Independently derived the repair rather than adopting the initial verdict.

independent_argument.realization: One round with zero true state, E=1 and equal-probability predictions(1,0)/(0,1) on[0,1]^2 realizes the displayed norm counterexample. It refutes the general identity, not Algorithm1 final performance.
independent_argument.comparator: For one round, true rewards all1, predicted rewards all0, all subsets allowed and xi=1, best true cumulative action value minus best predicted value isd while max-coordinate bias is1. This isolates the false intermediate comparator estimate.
independent_argument.repair: Keep realized Q_E=sumE_t^2. Rescaled outer experts regret gives sign*Z_Ei-U_T<=C(Lambda+sqrt(Lambda Q_E)) simultaneously for every coordinate/sign/event, with a single U_T=sum u_t. Thus max_i|Z_Ei|<=same B_E+U_T pathwise, then expectation/Jensen gives Emax<=C(Lambda+sqrt(Lambda n_E))+E U_T. For any swap the predicted-state term is nonpositive; each of its two true-minus-predicted utility terms is at most L||Z_Ea||infinity. Weighted averages lie in convexS, avoiding applying domain Lipschitzness outsideS. Consequently SwapReg<=2L sum_a||Z_Ea||infinity uniformly in the hindsight swap. Since sum_a n_Ea=T, expectation<=O(L[K Lambda+sqrt(KT Lambda)]). Conditional combinatorial regret is bounded pathwise by sum_e|Z_Exi,e|+sum_e|Z_Ee,xi,e|; using Q<=T and the common residual uniformly inxi yields Otilde(d sqrtT).

P2.alternative_and_dependency: Bounding each fixed swap in expectation alone does not justify expectation of its hindsight maximum; the repaired pathwise domination does. The common residual has expectedO(logT) under correct inner indexing and nonanticipation, absorbing K*logT into K Lambda. Missing factor2 and comparator dimension are not counterexamples to repaired final rates.
P2.severity_and_repair: Corrected to Major for invalid steps in the main decision-making derivations (Theorems3.7/4.1). The explicit stronger proof shows how up-to-log rates can survive, but does not make the printed core derivation valid. No claim of impossibility of the repaired results.

P3.source: Read multicalibration sketch p.6 and swap theorem p.7; independently inspected the cited primary Chen/Luo/Wei Theorem2 statement by read-only web.
P3.independent_argument: Summing m per-bin bounds yields O(T/m+m Lambda+sqrt(mT Lambda)) since sum n_i<=T and sum sqrt(n_i)<=sqrt(mT). Balancing T/m with sqrt(mT Lambda) sets m=(T/Lambda)^(1/3), giving T^(2/3)Lambda^(1/3)+T^(1/3)Lambda^(2/3), with integer truncation and an upper bound on the m-dependent logarithm. The printed m=T^(1/3) retains logarithms too. Swap retains K Lambda+sqrt(KT Lambda).
P3.alternative_and_dependency: The primary experts theorem explicitly has the logarithms and unit loss range. A sharper alternate analysis might remove some terms; no lower bound against log-free rates is proved. These accounting corrections preserve the qualitative exponents/efficiency and do not by themselves disprove the whole prediction method. Rounding must specify released grid predictions and matching event bins under pre-draw adversary commitment.
P3.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for the scoped rate accounting: state the logarithms or tildeO, or provide the sharper derivation. Exact log-free optimality/priority remain uncertified.

P4.source: Read Algorithm1/Step2 proofp.5, weighted-event footnotep.4 and full calibration/transparency proofsC.3-C.8 pp.16-19.
P4.independent_argument: For s,hat_s in[-1,1]^d and E in[0,1], signed outer losses range[-2,2]; division by2 puts them in Chen unit range, then restores a constant2. M pre-update plays z_tau with their own gradients satisfy max_s mean u(z_tau,s)=max_s sum<g_tau,z_tau-s>/M exactly because u(z_tau,s)=<g_tau,z_tau-s>. Algorithm1 adds one post-update point; with |u|<=2 changing from M to M+1 points changes any average by at most4/(M+1). Correct pairing plus M=t^2 therefore gives O(1/t)+O(1/t^2) per outer round. E=.5 yields n_T=T/4 while count(E=1)=0; E^2<=E and E^2<=1[E>0] supply correct alternatives. C.3 true-values-only premise is vacuous at s1=0,hat_s1=1 but utilities u(s)=s differ0 versus1. Ranging over predicted values repairs grouping; C.4-C.8 then follow by linearity, level-set partition and coarsening under the standing linear-utility assumption.
P4.alternative_and_dependency: These are bounded normalization/index/notation repairs, not a demonstrated asymptotic algorithm failure. The source already defines intended full calibration and linear utilities, which support the hats correction. The existing scalar OGD numerical fact is unchanged and used only as illustration, not a proof or new run.
P4.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; make ranges/index pairs/predicted-value quantification explicit. A corrected derivation, not the original exact identity, supplies the constant and summable index error.

scope_and_clarifications.source: Read Section2 information protocol, Section4 action/reward order, and AppendixD precision/oracle proof; independently checked the weighted-norm geometry proposed in the report.

independent_argument.geometry: At each outer round a_i=sum_{sigma,j}w_sigmaij>=0, sum_i a_i=1 and |g_i|<=a_i. Hence sum g_i^2/a_i<=sum a_i=1 for nonzero a_i; any two points in[-1,1]^d have weighted distance<=2. Weighted projected OGD has dimension-free O(sqrtM) regret if feasible projection is available. Zero-mass directions need a feasible representative of the reduced projection, not arbitrary unsupported coordinates.
independent_argument.timing: An adversary that sees current singleton action can reward only the other action. Learner reward0; best fixed rewardmax(N0,N1)>=T/2. Independent enumeration of256 length8 sequences gives minimum4. Section2 explicitly commits true state after seeing distribution but before the realization, excluding this adversary.
independent_argument.precision: Bounded coefficients do not alone imply bounded rational encoding length: 1/(2^b+1) is bounded by1 for arbitraryb. Truncation/projection error and separation geometry require quantified inputs; no complete global oracle complexity repair is certified.

scope_and_clarifications.alternative_and_dependency: BoxS supports weighted projection directly; a generic compact convexS requires suitable oracle/representation and handling of zero-weight coordinates. Thus the analytic geometry repair is conditional, not a complete implementation claim. Nonanticipation remains an interpretation request for Section4, not a false theorem under the intended Section2 model.
scope_and_clarifications.severity_and_repair: C1/C2 remain Needs Evidence with explicit scope. No experiments, author implementation, historical runs, full external-proof audit or priority certification performed.
